verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook generates reports itself, including briefing documents, study guides, FAQs, and custom report types. Chat responses keep their tables when saved as notes, notes export to Google Docs or Sheets, and notebooks can be shared publicly by link. However, the docs never say that generated reports contain explicit sections or tables, and they never describe sharing a report specifically. Missing for 10: documented section structure and tables within generated reports, report-specific sharing or export, and independent hands-on corroboration of report quality.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders

citations.quote: Create your own, or choose from FAQ, study guide, briefing document, or an AI suggested report type.
Transform your sources into approachable formats such as study guides, briefings, audio overviews, mind maps, and more.
When you save a response as a note, the original format—including tables and clickable inline citations—gets saved.
You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.
You can make your notebook public and share a link with anyone with a Google account.
